# ZDNET

> ZDNET is a leading technology news and reviews publication covering innovations in consumer electronics, computing, mobile devices, and smart home technology with expert comparisons and buying guides.

ZDNET provides comprehensive tech coverage including breaking news from major events like CES, detailed product reviews and comparisons across categories like laptops, smartphones, earbuds, and smart devices, plus how-to guides for optimizing technology performance. The site features expert analysis from contributors including Prakhar Khanna, Kerry Wan, Jack Wallen, and Elyse Betters Picaro.
